race.comment: HARSH (4) has established herself as one of the more progressive stayers of the SA ranks this prep and finds another nice race. This looks a very winnable race with the way she's progressing and she comes through the strongest formline. Can land the knockout blow. ROMANS LUCK (3) got things back on track in a big way last start when taking out the Port Augusta Cup. This is obviously tougher but expect him to push forward again and give a bold sight. MIRACLE SPIN (1) dug deep to get the verdict last week on the Parks track. Backs up quickly and suspect he won't be bothered by the further rise in trip. THE TRUE BELIEVER (6) has been strong through the line in his last two and deserves each-way consideration.
